description: Compare the monthly and annual cost of Shopify Basic, Grow, Advanced and Plus for a sales volume and payment mix, with break-even sales between plans and requirements only Plus covers. Uses Shopify's published prices and rates for the US, UK, Australia, Norway or New Zealand (market); Norway's Plus and New Zealand's subscriptions are billed in EUR or USD and converted at a dated ECB reference rate, reported in exchangeRate; pass exchangeRate to use your own. The variable Plus platform fee is unpublished, so pass plusQuoteMonthly if you have a quote. Only monthlyGmv is required; the rest defaults to one US brand fully on Shopify Payments with yearly billing.

averageOrderValue.description: Average order value in market sales currency; drives the per-order fixed card fee.

billing.description: Billing for Basic, Grow and Advanced.

brands.description: Separate brands; each needs its own plan or Plus contract.

checkoutExtensions.description: Whether checkout UI extensions are needed.

exchangeRate.description: Local sales currency units per foreign subscription currency unit (NOK/EUR in Norway; NZD/USD in New Zealand), up to 1,000,000. Overrides the market's default ECB reference rate; the estimate's exchangeRate reports which rate was applied.

internationalCardShare.description: Share of Shopify Payments sales on international cards (0-1).

monthlyGmv.description: Monthly online sales in the selected market sales currency across all stores.

plusQuoteMonthly.description: Monthly Plus price in market sales currency from a Shopify quote; replaces the list price.

premiumCardShare.description: Share of Shopify Payments sales on premium cards in the US, or Amex cards in other markets (0-1).

providerFixedCents.description: Third-party provider's own fixed fee per order in cents.

providerRateBps.description: Third-party provider's own rate in basis points (290 = 2.9%).

sameBrandStores.description: Stores for the same brand, such as regional stores.

shopifyPaymentsShare.description: Share of online sales processed by Shopify Payments (0-1); the rest uses a third-party provider.

staffAccounts.description: Staff accounts needed besides the store owner.
